full_judgment: 7. The other line of decisions as has been reflected in Admiralty Suit Nos. 23 of 1992, 36 of 1996 and 143 of 1999 is in favour of extension of the Bank Guarantee even though sought for after expiry of the time. It may be mentioned in one of the cases ie in Admiralty Suit No. 24 of 1995, the defendant of his own extended the Bank Guarantee.
